description: Ranked full-text search over everything written about the products: names and aliases, summaries, specs, features, parts, materials, finishes, standards and organizations. Use it when you have a description rather than exact filters ("ablative heat shield on a Mars rover", "regeneratively cooled engine", "thermal blankets for CHEOPS"); use find_products when you can name a kind, size, maker or material. Returns the best matches first with a short snippet of the matching text and the page; open one with get_product. An empty answer means no catalogued text matches those words.

query.description: Words or a short phrase; quotes and minus work (web-search style)

name: search_products
title: Search space products by description
